datasets.title: Asia–Africa World Development Indicators

datasets.source: World Bank WDI; upstream providers identified per indicator

datasets.title: Historical product/service demand & supply references
datasets.description: Curated product records plus latest WDI food/agricultural and service trade proxies. Mixed units and periods; never sum as a single market total.
datasets.license: Source-specific terms apply; factual references with attribution

datasets.title: Official-source provider directory

datasets.license: Public factual references; source website rights retained

datasets.title: Africa–Asia bilateral product trade
datasets.description: Annual UN Comtrade extracts for food and apparel the observatory tracks, including cashew, cocoa products, palm oil, sesame, and raw cotton. Bilateral statistical values, not orders or inventory. A missing pair is not zero trade. Do not add a line to its chapter or to a sibling product.
datasets.source: United Nations Comtrade, public preview API
datasets.license: UN Comtrade terms of use; attribute United Nations Comtrade

datasets.title: Reference prices for observatory commodities
datasets.description: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly nominal US dollar quotes from January 2015 for cocoa, coffee, tea, palm oil, rice, wheat, oranges, and cotton. A missing month was not published. Not bilateral unit values.
datasets.source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), workbook updated on November 03, 2026
datasets.license: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0)

fields.country: ISO3 in WDI observations; country names in curated records
fields.value: Original numeric source value; no missing-to-zero conversion
fields.unit: Indicator-specific; retained in API and exports
